scientific_integrity: Proof based on exact concatenation identity and four-letter morphism; finite DP program independently tests 2048 cases; finite checks are not substitutes for proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact all-length theorem concerns Thue–Morse prefixes, not arbitrary shifted factors; conventional nonperiodicity of Thue–Morse is used in one corollary. Independently reviewed mathematical validation and definitive priority checks are outstanding.
title: Exact automatic fair-length profile of Thue–Morse prefixes
